## Changelog
### Added
- Added blank Carrier layout template.
- Added carrier layout template for Case 1 conditions.
- Added carrier layout template for Case 3 conditions.

### Fixed
- Fixed update download can be truncated.
- Fixed editing strip can raise KeyError if controller deletes or transfers strip.
- Fixed breakout inserts strips in the wrong place with several controllers.
- Fixed the host's cursor jumps to the end while typing in Notes and combos.
- Fixed flash timer is never stopped or started after remote updates.
- Fixed headless server banner can crash on non-UTF-8 output

### Changed
- Changed generate squawk to no longer produce emergency squawks (7500/7600/7700).
- Reorganized menu layout options.
- Completely reworked how server and client connections talk to each other.
  - Added heartbeat for better accidental disconnect detection.
  - Added better auto-reconnect logic.
  - Added popup to indicate when you have unexpectedly disconnected
  - Added better logic to try and recover state when a controller how unexpectedly disconnects, reconnects.
- Changed logos for server and client.
